articles.title: France sets presidential election date as Macron finishes final term
articles.summary: France announced the dates for its next presidential election as April 18 and May 2, 2027, marking the end of Macron's second and final term.

articles.title: Thailand denies viral claim Macron knelt before king
articles.summary: Thailand's foreign ministry denied claims from an AI-generated image that French President Macron knelt before Thailand's king during the king's state visit to Paris.

articles.title: Macron's 'Versailles diplomacy' yields mixed results after a decade in power
articles.summary: Macron hosted the G7 summit at Versailles and courted President Trump, but analysts noted his diplomatic efforts have not consistently translated into lasting strategic influence.

articles.title: 'For sure': Macron to preach stronger Europe vision at G7 swansong
articles.summary: Macron hosted his final G7 summit as French president, promoting his vision for European strategic autonomy while facing challenges in translating that vision into collective European action.
